errors.text_span: като се разделят на пет категории
errors.evidence: The pie chart and the legend clearly show six categories (slices), not five. The category "Не се предоставят" has been omitted from the count.

errors.text_span: Всички пет сектора са визуализирани с различни цветове и са етикетирани със съответните проценти вътре в тях.
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect generalization. Firstly, there are six sectors. Secondly, two of the sectors (the green one for "81 - 100 услуги" and the light blue one for "Не се предоставят") are not labeled with percentages in the image.
The slice corresponding to the category "21 - 50 услуги" is colored red, not brown.
The green sector, representing "81 - 100 услуги", does not have a percentage label in the image. The value "2,9%" is hallucinated.
The description completely omits the sixth category, "Не се предоставят", which is represented by a light blue slice and is present in the legend.

errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. The order shown is 32.6%, 15.2%, 13%, [unknown value], 28.3%, [unknown value], which is not a descending sequence.

errors.text_span: Вътре в секторите са изписани процентите, които отговарят на дялите на всяка категория.
errors.evidence: This sentence unnecessarily repeats an assertion made at the beginning of the description, which is also factually incorrect.
